title: The Application Launcher's search bar should be Right-Clickable for pasting texts
line: Right-clicking Kickoff's search field (and any other Plasma text field) now opens a menu with Paste, Copy, Cut, Undo and Select All.
explanation: Plasma Components 3's TextField, which Kickoff's search field and most Plasma text fields use, had no context menu, so a right-click did nothing and pasting needed the keyboard. Christoph Wolk's open MR libplasma!1576 adds a TextField context menu (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All, with editing and copy actions hidden for password fields) through Qt's ContextMenu attached property, and makes hidden MenuItems take no space.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3: add TextField context menu

Plasma's TextFields don't have a context menu. This makes it hard to
paste without using keyboard shortcuts, and to use other common editing
actions (though those should be less rare).

Luckily we already have implementations in Union and qqc2-desktop-style,
which we can be heavily inspired by. More specifically, we use union's
much simpler method of loading the context menu, and desktop style's
menu contents, but remove much of the complexity and in particular the
spell checking, as this is likely rarely useful in Plasma, so we end up
with a relatively compact and understandable implementation that works
well for the most common uses: seach fields and password fields.

BUG: 525065
BUG: 525063
BUG: 524291

media.caption: Master: right-clicking Kickoff's search field shows no menu.
With the MR: right-click opens an edit menu; Paste inserts the clipboard text and the search runs.

review.text: Adding a context menu to Plasma Components 3 TextField via T.ContextMenu.menu in libplasma is the right layer to fix Kickoff and all Plasma text fields at once. However, the staged open MR (libplasma!1576) has several issues that should be fixed before merge: it uses qsTr() instead of KI18n (leaving all menu strings untranslated in libplasma), registers always-enabled T.Action shortcuts (StandardKey.*) eagerly on every TextField instance even though PC3.MenuItem does not display shortcuts (causing window-level shortcut hijacking/ambiguity when multiple TextFields or other controls share a window), and leaves PC3.MenuSeparator uncollapsed when invisible so password/read-only menus have blank gaps.
changes: Replace qsTr(...) in TextFieldContextMenu.qml with KI18n calls (i18nd("libplasma6", ...) or i18ndc) so menu labels are extracted and translated in libplasma.

Remove shortcut: StandardKey.* from the T.Action items in TextFieldContextMenu.qml (TextInput already handles standard editing shortcuts natively and PC3.MenuItem does not render them), preventing active window-wide shortcut hijacking and ambiguous shortcut conflicts across multiple TextFields.

Collapse invisible PC3.MenuSeparator height (matching MenuItem.qml) so password and read-only fields do not leave blank vertical gaps, and test password, read-only, and multi-TextField windows (as well as verifying MenuItem's height binding does not regress other PC3 Menus).

Check target.echoMode === TextInput.Normal in __showPasswordRestrictedActions() (also protecting TextInput.NoEcho), disable Select All when target.length === 0, drop the stray blank-line edit in CMakeLists.txt, and fix the 'seach' typo in the commit message.

reviews.text: Right layer and right UX: a PC3 TextField context menu fixes Kickoff and every other Plasma text field, and the screenshot shows Paste working. But the menu strings use qsTr() while libplasma is translated only through ki18n (TRANSLATION_DOMAIN libplasma6, xgettext Messages.sh with no qm catalog), so Undo/Copy/Paste/etc. will never be extracted or translated. The patch also drops an unrelated blank line in src/declarativeimports/CMakeLists.txt, and the MenuItem height change affects every PC3 Menu but only this one was checked.
changes: Replace qsTr(...) with i18nd("libplasma6", ...) in TextFieldContextMenu.qml (or add a Qt qm translation pipeline, which libplasma does not have)
Drop the unrelated blank-line removal in src/declarativeimports/CMakeLists.txt
Spot-check a couple of other PC3 Menus (e.g. a Kickoff item context menu, task manager menu) for the new height: visible ? undefined : 0 MenuItem behaviour
Fix the 'seach' typo in the commit message
